notes.summary: The page continues a statement about the n.th power homomorphism in the Picard prescheme, explains the interest in a method involving non flat descent and the absence of a good effectivity criterion, states a theorem and Corollary 1 about representability of Picard-functor homomorphisms, writes an exactness expression and a factorisation vu, and begins an explanatory continuation. The restriction to a suitable non empty open set is underlined and accompanied by a marginal query. This is a description of the page, without a claim of proof verification.

notes.authorship: A typed letter continuation with manuscript additions; this page alone supplies no signature or named author. Manuscript hands are left unnamed.
notes.h_editorial_notes: H has text on this page. Its note about and B and another page is excluded from the transcription, and no other page was consulted. Its note about the marginal question and underlining is descriptive, not an uncertainty mark.
notes.mathematical_scope: Only written glyphs, nesting of indices, and formula order were inspected. No mathematical fact or theorem was used to choose a reading, and no proof check was performed. In particular, both written Pic subscripts remain X/S.
notes.spacing: The space before the full stop after the Pic formula is entered explicitly. The f label remains attached to via. The comma spacing in the cancelled phrase remains an explicit alternative. The crowded e in specifically is recorded from the visible displaced impression.
